name: StellarSwap
description: Built-in ABI for the StellarSwap AMM DEX router, auto-seeded on indexer startup so swap and liquidity events decode out of the box.

functions.name: swap
functions.description: Swap an exact input amount of one token for another.

functions.name: swap_exact_tokens_for_tokens
functions.description: Router-style swap: exact input amount for a minimum guaranteed output amount.

functions.name: add_liquidity
functions.description: Provide liquidity to a token pair pool in exchange for LP tokens.

functions.name: remove_liquidity
functions.description: Burn LP tokens to withdraw the underlying token pair from a pool.
